short: A Russian next-generation attack helicopter featuring a distinctive coaxial rotor system.
full:
The Kamov Ka-52 "Alligator" entered service with the Russian military in April 2011 as a two-seat derivative of the single-seat Ka-50. It utilizes Kamov's signature coaxial contra-rotating rotors, eliminating the need for a tail rotor and providing exceptional maneuverability, especially in tight spaces or high crosswinds. Uniquely for helicopters, it features side-by-side seating for the crew and is equipped with an ejection seat system.

Designed for armed reconnaissance and anti-armor missions, the Ka-52 operates across all weather conditions and is heavily armed with a 30mm cannon and various anti-tank guided missiles. It has been deployed extensively in the Syrian Civil War and the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine, where it has seen heavy combat and sustained significant losses against modern anti-aircraft systems.
